summary: One search over everything an app can do, over the page on Mod+K, which closes it again: a dialog box a third of the way down the window with the search at its top, the commands in groups under their titles (each row its icon, its label, a quiet hint or code after it, and at its end a summary, its kind or the keys that run it), the app's own search results under them, and an optional strip at its foot. Its active row wears the highlight every list of choices does. Choosing a row runs it and closes the palette. A command whose onSelect answers a promise holds the palette open and its row busy until it settles: fulfilled, the palette closes; rejected, it stays and says why under the rows. Once it has run busy-release (5 seconds) a Stop waiting row appears, and it or Escape lets the palette go, the command left to settle unheard.

sokkel-ui-egui: crates/core/src/widgets/menu.rs (CommandPalette, CommandGroup, PaletteOutcome, PaletteWords, palette_shortcut, action_row)

anatomy.box: parts/dialog's box, a third of the way down the window and centered across, edged in border-strong on elevation-dialog: 384 wide from 768 (width), padded by palette-inset, with no close of its own. The page under it is shaded by the dialog's backdrop.
anatomy.description: A line over the search saying what is being chosen (description), for a palette that stands as a chooser.
anatomy.search: The search at the top: a search icon at its start, then the query or words.placeholder, on the input's tint. Focus starts in it.
anatomy.searchIcon: The search's icon, at half strength.
anatomy.list: The groups and the search's results, scrolling past 384 or 60 percent of the window, fading at its foot.
anatomy.groupTitle: A group's title over its rows, small and muted, its start level with the rows' icons.
anatomy.separator: A rule between two groups, across the palette's whole width.
anatomy.row: One command: its icon, its label (in the code face with mono), a hint or code after it, and at its end a summary, its kind and its keys, or a spinner while it runs. Washed in the accent while it is the active row, its icon, label and quiet words in accent-foreground.
anatomy.icon: A command's icon at the row's start.
anatomy.hint: A quiet fact after the label, in words (hint); a disabled command's reason in its place; in a status ink with tone.
anatomy.code: An addressable code after the label, in the code face (code).
anatomy.meta: A quiet summary at the row's end in the code face with tabular figures (meta): a count, a size, when it last ran. In the muted ink on a one-line row and a two-line row alike, accent-foreground on the active row; in a status ink with metaTone, which stays its tone, so a summary saying something is missing reads critical. Below 640 it folds under the label.
anatomy.kind: What the row is (Page, Form), faint, before its keys, where its group's kind does not already say it.
anatomy.keys: The keys that run the command outside the palette, as key caps, a sequence's two presses with words.sequence between.
anatomy.twoLineRow: A command with a detail or artwork: two lines, drawn as a search result is, a picture or its icon on a tile at its start and its meta, hint or code at its end.
anatomy.spinner: While the command's promise is pending: a spinner at its row's end in the keys' place, named words.running.
anatomy.stopWaiting: Once a running command has run busy-release: words.stopWaiting, a row at the list's top, which closes the palette and lets the command go, aborting the signal it was handed.
anatomy.refusal: Why the last command was refused, under the list across the palette's whole width, its words inset as the rows' are: the rejection's words, else words.refused.
anatomy.empty: words.empty, centered, while no command matches and the app's search has not failed or shown its wait.
anatomy.results: The app's search results under the commands, grouped by kind as parts of the search draw them; Searching once a wait with nothing listed has run wait-shown, its failure with a Retry row, and a row to see all results at the list's foot.
anatomy.foot: An optional strip at the box's foot (foot): the app's mark and name at its start, and at its end the active row's verb beside Enter and words.palette beside the keys that open it.
anatomy.close: On a touch screen, which has no Escape: words.close, a small ghost button at the foot, in the keys' place or in a strip of its own.

groups.does: The commands under their titles: [{ title, commands, rank?, verb?, kind? }], listed by rank, lower first, one group to a title.

commands.does: A group's commands: { id, label, icon?, hint?, code?, meta?, metaTone?, mono?, keys?, next?, keywords?, detail?, tone?, artwork?, round?, disabled?, verb?, kind?, onSelect }.

onSelect.does: Runs the command. Nothing back, or a value: the palette closes. A promise: the palette holds open, the row busy, until it settles, Escape, a press outside, its Close and Mod+K doing nothing meanwhile; once it has run busyRelease, Stop waiting, Escape and the Close let the palette go and the command's answer goes unheard. The command is handed a signal that is aborted when the palette lets it go before it settles (Stop waiting, a released Escape or Close, or the palette closing or going away), so it can stop its work, and the app says how the work ended elsewhere since the palette has closed; it is never aborted once the command has settled. Fulfilled, it closes; rejected, it stays open and says why under the rows. A command that throws is refused the same way.

meta.does: A quiet summary at the row's end.

metaTone.does: Sets meta in a status ink in place of the quiet one.

tone.does: Sets a two-line row's second line, or a one-line row's hint, in a status ink.

disabled.does: true, or why: the command is listed at half opacity, passed over by the arrows and never run, its reason in the hint's place.

search.does: The app's own search, its results listed under the commands: { search, onOpen, onSeeAll?, minQuery?, debounce?, words? }. debounce is the pause in typing before a changed query is asked; at 0 each is asked at once.

defaultQuery.does: What the search holds each time the palette opens.

filter.does: How the commands are matched: fuzzy by the letters typed in their order, best first; terms by every word typed, a label starting with it first; or the app's own score for each command.

foot.does: The strip at the foot: { mark?, name?, keys? }.

width.does: How wide from 768 up: sm 384, md 512 or lg 672, for a chooser whose rows say more.

description.does: A line over the search saying what is being chosen; read as the dialog's description.

wrap.does: Lets each row's label, hint and code wrap rather than end in an ellipsis.

busyRelease.does: ms a running command holds the palette before Stop waiting appears and Escape lets it go: the busy-release token.
busyRelease.sokkel-ui: CommandPalette busyRelease, BUSY_RELEASE (lib/durations, from busy-release) by default

box.note: sm, from 768; md 512, lg 672 (width). palette-inset is 4 in most themes and 8 in indigo.

search.note: 4 in from the box's pad at its top and sides (layout); the icon 8 in, the text 6 after it.

group.note: Around a group's title and rows.

groupTitle.note: 32 tall: 6 over and under a 20 line.

row.note: 34 tall where palette-row-inset-y is 6 (a 22 line), 38 in indigo; a finger tall below 768. The label, hint and code 8 apart (layout).

meta.note: In the code face, with tabular figures; 12 after the label (layout).

keys.note: Key caps (parts/tooltip's keys), 20 tall; the kind 8 before them.

refusal.note: Across the box's whole width; its words inset by palette-inset and palette-row-inset-x.

listMaxHeight.note: Or 60 percent of the window, the less; the list scrolls past it.

listBottom.note: Under the last group, over the box's pad.

searchInset.note: The search's room from the box's pad at its top and sides; none under it.

labelGap.note: Between the label, the hint and the code.

metaGap.note: Between the label and the meta.

kindGap.note: Between the kind and the keys.

metaFoldBelow.note: Below this window width a meta folds under its label.

widthFrom.note: The window width (768) from which the width option holds, as a dialog's does; below it the box is the window less 32.

busyRelease.note: How long a running command holds the palette (5000 ms) before Stop waiting appears and Escape and the Close let it go.

searchingAfter.note: How long the app's search waits for an answer (300 ms) before Searching shows or the earlier results dim; a quicker answer draws neither.

rest.means: Open: the search holds defaultQuery, every command is listed by group, and the first row is active.

active.means: The row the arrows or the pointer are on: washed in the accent, as every list of choices is; Enter runs it. The first row drawn becomes active whenever the active one is gone.
active.reached: the arrows, the pointer, or the rows changing

disabled.means: A command that cannot run now: listed, passed over by the arrows, never run, its reason in its hint's place.

empty.means: No command matches and the app's search has not failed or shown its wait: words.empty. A wait shorter than wait-shown leaves it standing, so a quick answer never swaps it for Searching.

searching.means: The app's search has waited wait-shown for its answer: with no results listed, words.searching under the commands; with an earlier query's results listed, they are dimmed and passed over. A shorter wait draws neither, the earlier results only out of reach, so a search that answers at once never flickers.

busy.means: A command's onSelect answered a promise that has not settled: the palette holds open (Escape, a press outside, its Close and Mod+K do nothing), the row is busy with a spinner named words.running at its end, and another choice is ignored until it settles.

released.means: A command has run busy-release without settling: words.stopWaiting stands at the list's top, and it, Escape and the Close let the palette go; a press outside and Mod+K still do nothing. Closing cancels nothing: the command settles on its own and its answer, a refusal included, is not said.

refused.means: The promise was rejected, or onSelect threw: the palette stays open and the refusal stays shown under the rows, the rejection's own words or words.refused, until typing or choosing again clears it.

critical.means: A meta or hint in the critical ink.

warning.means: A meta or hint in the warning ink.

good.means: A meta or hint in the good ink.

info.means: A meta or hint in the info ink.

twoLine.means: A row with a detail or artwork, drawn as a search result is: its meta, hint or code the quiet fact at its end.

phone.means: Below 768 the search and every row are a finger tall; below 640 a meta folds under its label.

touch.means: A touch screen, which has no Escape: Close stands at the foot, and the foot's keys give way to it.

rest.note: parts/dialog's box: a 1px border-strong edge and elevation-dialog under it.

active.note: Unless a tone sets it, which stays.
Unless a tone sets it, which stays.

twoLine.note: The search result's quiet fact at the row's end, in the same ink as on one line.

released.note: A row as the command rows are, in the box's ink, its icon muted-foreground, on accent while it is the active row.

refused.note: A circled alert before the words, in the same ink; the rule along its top.

keyboard.does: Opens the palette, from a field too; on a Mac Ctrl+K as well. A second press closes it, in a Shell or not, usePaletteShortcut included, unless a command is running.
Types into the search, narrowing the commands.
Moves the active row, past disabled rows; it stops at the first and the last, as every list of choices does.
Makes the first or the last row active.
Runs the active command: the palette closes, or stays open and busy while its promise is pending; on Stop waiting, closes the palette and lets the command go.
keyboard.when: a row is active and no command is running, or Stop waiting is active

keyboard.does: Closes the palette, focus back where it was; once a running command has run busy-release, closes it and lets the command go.
keyboard.when: the palette is open, and no command is running or it has run busy-release

appText.commands: Every group's title, verb and kind, and every command's label, hint, code, meta, detail, keywords, verb, kind and reason when disabled.
appText.refusal: A rejection's own words, said in words.refused's place.
appText.description: The line over the search for a chooser.

sokkel-ui: cmdk's Command inside the library's dialog (ui/command): the box is Base UI's Dialog, a portal over the page it makes inert; its title and description are read to a screen reader only.

cmdk's own Ctrl+N, Ctrl+J, Ctrl+P and Ctrl+K are off (vimBindings false, the Command primitive's default), so Ctrl+K is the palette's key alone. The open palette binds Mod+K itself (useShortcuts, before the shell's own), closing through the same hold a running command keeps.
fuzzy is cmdk's own matching; terms and an app's function score the commands themselves (filterCommands), the order then theirs.
In a Shell the palette takes the app's groups and each screen's (useCommands), ranked, a screen's first at equal rank.
The active row is held as cmdk's value, so the foot can say its verb.
A command that settles after the palette closed, or opened again, is let go.
pointer-coarse decides the touch screen's Close; max-md the finger heights and, with md:max-w, the width; max-sm the meta's fold.
The list fades at its foot (scroll-fade-b), and keeps the see-all row in sight under the scrolling rows.

The wait is BUSY_RELEASE, generated from the busy-release token (lib/durations); useBusyRelease releases the palette once it has run, and only Escape (escape-key, close-watcher) and the Close (close-press) are heeded then. A command settling after the palette closed is let go (runCommand's current).

useSearch says slow once a query has waited WAIT_SHOWN (lib/durations, from wait-shown), timed as useBusyRelease times its wait, and searchWait (lib/search) turns it into the Searching line and the dimmed results; an earlier query's results are out of reach from the wait's first moment, a choice of one ignored.
sokkel-ui-egui: CommandPalette::new(id, groups, &mut query, &mut highlight).words(..).show(ctx) returns PaletteOutcome { run, close }; the app runs the command it names by group and index.
A row is the dropdown menu's MenuItem::Action, drawn in the palette's look (action_row with RowLook::Palette).
place_commands and appearance_commands build groups from the rail's places and the look.

As of 26b411f, CommandPalette draws the box 384 wide a third of the way down over a shade/10 backdrop, padded by palette-inset, the search a control tall on input/30, group titles 32 tall at text.badge, rows 34 tall with an icon and keys or a hint, the active row on muted, rules between groups, words.placeholder and words.empty, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter and Escape.
